stories.headline: Anthropic buys $3.4B of gas generators for its AI data centers
stories.body: Anthropic agreed to pay $3.4 billion for 1.7 gigawatts of gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions, the FT reported. It's the largest known single power-equipment purchase by an AI lab.
stories.why: Electricity, not just chips, is now the bottleneck for building AI.

stories.headline: DeepMind's AI agents found two weaknesses in old 1024-bit encryption
stories.body: Guided by human experts, Google DeepMind's AI agents found a cheaper way to forge signatures and to crack many legacy 1024-bit RSA keys. Modern 2048-bit keys are not affected.
stories.why: AI is now doing real cryptography research, compressing years of work into weeks.

stories.headline: 800+ copies of an AI hacking tool were left open online
stories.body: Internet scanner Censys found more than 800 deployments of Artex, an AI-powered hacking tool, reachable from the web with no password at all.
stories.why: A misconfigured AI attack tool is a weapon anyone can pick up.

stories.headline: Almost no one books Uber through AI agents, Uber says
stories.body: Despite the buzz around AI agents doing tasks for us, Uber says very few rides are actually booked through them.
stories.why: The agent hype is still well ahead of what people actually use.

stories.short: Google buys a data center project
stories.headline: Google buys Crusoe's troubled Wyoming data center project
stories.body: AI cloud company Crusoe sold its struggling Wyoming data center project to Google.
stories.why: The race for AI computing capacity keeps pushing big tech to buy wherever it can.
